## What each lane will not do

- **NFL spreads and totals**: matchup, pace and efficiency numbers as a pick on their own (they feed the game script only); first-half habits and openers (failed tests); betting splits and line movement (never a reason)
- **College football spreads and totals**: staked full-game picks from its own script alone (shown only, research 16); weather and wind (college wind test running, research 20); props (no college props model); betting splits and line movement (never a reason)
- **NBA spreads and totals**: rest, travel and back-to-backs as a pick on their own (priced, research 14 2d); staked full-game picks from its own script (shown only, research 16); betting splits and line movement (never a reason)
- **NFL Wong teasers**: college or NBA teasers (neither clears break-even); 13-point or 3+ team teasers (leaks); legs outside the Wong ranges or with totals over 49
- **NFL player props**: any Wagerhouse prop price (Bet Builder is not readable; each pick says the worst line and price to take); props the model and Pinnacle disagree on by 15+ points until the research agent clears them
- **NBA player props**: any Wagerhouse prop price (Bet Builder is not readable; each pick says the worst line and price to take); props the model and Pinnacle disagree on by 15+ points until the research agent clears them
